task.title: Authenticate with OAuth 2.0
task.shortdesc: Obtain a Bearer access token using your PayPal app credentials to authorize REST API calls.

ul.li: A PayPal Developer account with at least one app created

step.cmd: Send a POST request to the token endpoint using HTTP Basic Auth.
Parse the access_token from the JSON response.
step.stepresult: Token is valid for expires_in seconds (9 hours). Cache it and reuse rather than generating a new one per request.

step.cmd: Include the Bearer token in all subsequent API request headers.

result.p: All PayPal REST API endpoints are now accessible with this token until it expires.

postreq.p: Proactively refresh the token 5 minutes before expiry to prevent 401 errors mid-request. See for token-related error codes.
